signature.instructions: Identify the political committee that sponsored a fundraising email. The committee's name is present in the email text itself.

module_src:
class IdentifyCommitteeModule(dspy.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # Fallback only for emails the deterministic code cannot resolve.
        self.fallback = dspy.Predict(dspy.Signature('email_body: str -> committee: str', "Identify the political committee that sponsored a fundraising email. The committee's name is present in the email text itself."))

    def forward(self, **inputs):
        import re

        email_body = inputs.get("email_body", "") or ""

        def clean(name):
            if name is None:
                return None
            name = name.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ")
            name = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", name).strip()
            name = name.strip(" .,:;-—–()[]{}\"'|")
            return name.strip()

        def fix_spacing(name):
            if not name:
                return name
            spaced = re.sub(r"(?<=[a-z])(?=[A-Z])", " ", name)
            return spaced

        stop_patterns = [
            r"\bP\.?\s?O\.?\s*Box\b",
            r"\bPO\s+Box\b",
            r"\bTreasurer\b",
            r"\bThis email\b",
            r"\bThis message\b",
            r"\bThis is a\b",
            r"\bYou are receiving\b",
            r"\bYou can\b",
            r"\bDon'?t\b",
            r"\bWe Need\b",
            r"\bNOT\s*AUTHORIZED\b",
            r"\bNot\s*authorized\b",
            r"\bNotauthorized\b",
            r"\band not authorized\b",
            r"\bAND\s+NOT\s+AUTHORIZED\b",
            r"\bAuthorized by\b",
            r"\ba joint fundraising\b",
            r"\bUse of\b",
            r"\bIf you\b",
            r"\bPlease support\b",
            r"\bPlease\b",
            r"\bYour Support\b",
            r"\bcopyright\b",
            r"\bwww\.",
            r"\bhttp",
            r"\bclick here\b",
            r"\bUnsubscribe\b",
            r"\bAll rights reserved\b",
            r"\bReceive less\b",
            r"\bReceive fewer\b",
            r"\bDrawer\b",
            r"\bStreet\b",
            r"\bSuite\b",
            r"\bContributions\b",
            r"\(\s*\)",
            r"\d{2,}\s+[A-Za-z]",
            r"\.\s+[A-Z]",
            r"\.\s*$",
            r"\s\|\s",
            r"\s#\S",
        ]

        legal_suffix_re = re.compile(
            r"\b(?:PAC|Committee|Congress|Senate|Inc|Incorporated|LLC|"
            r"Fund|Party|Account|Victory|Campaign|State|House|President|"
            r"Values|Action)\b",
            flags=re.IGNORECASE,
        )

        def trim_after_comma(name):
            idx = name.find(",")
            if idx != -1:
                name = name[:idx]
            return name

        def strip_parenthetical(name):
            idx = name.find("(")
            if idx != -1:
                name = name[:idx]
            return name.strip()

        def truncate_at_legal_suffix(name):
            m = None
            for mm in legal_suffix_re.finditer(name):
                m = mm
            if m is not None:
                return name[:m.end()]
            return name

        def strip_trailing_conjunctions(name):
            words = name.split()
            dangling = {"and", "or", "the", "a", "an", "of", "for", "to", "by", "with"}
            while words and words[-1].lower() in dangling:
                words.pop()
            return " ".join(words)

        def extract_from_tail(tail):
            end = len(tail)
            for cp in stop_patterns:
                mm = re.search(cp, tail, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
                if mm and mm.start() < end:
                    end = mm.start()
            raw = tail[:end]
            raw = trim_after_comma(raw)
            raw = strip_parenthetical(raw)
            name = clean(raw)
            if not name:
                return None
            name = truncate_at_legal_suffix(name)
            name = strip_parenthetical(name)
            name = clean(name)
            name = fix_spacing(name)
            name = strip_trailing_conjunctions(name)
            name = clean(name)
            if not name:
                return None
            words = name.split()
            n = len(words)
            for k in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
                first = " ".join(words[:k]).lower()
                second = " ".join(words[k:2 * k]).lower()
                if first == second:
                    name = " ".join(words[:k])
                    break
            if name.lower().startswith("the "):
                name = name[4:].strip()
            name = strip_trailing_conjunctions(name)
            return name

        # Primary pattern: "Paid for by <NAME>" (also "Paid for and authorized by").
        # Allow the whitespace after "by" to be optional so glued text like
        # "Paid for byJames for NY 2026" is captured (the parser inserts spaces later).
        candidates = []
        for m in re.finditer(
            r"[Pp][Aa][Ii][Dd]\s*for\s*(?:and\s*authorized\s*)?by\s*(?:the\s+)?(.+)",
            email_body, flags=re.IGNORECASE,
        ):
            tail = m.group(1)
            # If the tail starts glued to an uppercase word (e.g. "James..."),
            # re-space any camel-glue at the very start so fix_spacing can work.
            name = extract_from_tail(tail)
            if name and len(name) > 2:
                candidates.append(name)

        result = candidates[0] if candidates else None

        def looks_confident(name):
            if not name:
                return False
            wc = len(name.split())
            if wc < 1 or wc > 12:
                return False
            low = name.lower()
            bad = ["unsubscribe", "click here", "http", "www.",
                   "receiving", "rights reserved",
                   "we need", "please support", "your support",
                   "not authorized", "notauthorized", "authorized by"]
            if any(b in low for b in bad):
                return False
            last = name.split()[-1].lower()
            if last in {"and", "or", "the", "a", "an", "of", "for", "to", "by", "with"}:
                return False
            if "(" in name or ")" in name:
                return False
            if not re.search(r"[A-Za-z]", name):
                return False
            return True

        if not looks_confident(result):
            r = self.fallback(email_body=email_body)
            result = clean(r.committee) or (r.committee if r.committee else "")

        return dspy.Prediction(committee=result)
